conviction_note: No forecast revision (none mid-year in three years, even through large misses), no capital-return change (fixed 30-yen interim, 50% payout policy, no buyback history found) and no new-year guide, so the print is the quarter alone. The quarter looks firm on operating profit and soft on revenue, and both are computable from the Q1 tanshin. What is left is a name that closed lower on 9 of its last 11 releases, measured on the real 15:30 release dates, including after a 6.6% IFIS beat in July. Findings sum to -0.6. The scaled number is smaller, -0.24 (p_up 45 on abs 2.4), because the reaction-pattern evidence is only 11 events and the profit side is a genuine positive.
bar: IFIS consensus FY2027/2 pretax profit 12,817m yen against the company plan of 12,600m (kabuyoho/IFIS, https://kabuyoho.jp/reportNews?bcode=6183, consensus as of 2026-07-21). There is no H1 company plan and no H1 consensus, so the H1 bar is derived: last year's H1 share of full-year pretax (5,767/12,290 = 46.9%) applied to 12,817 gives about 6,010m. My H1 estimate of about 6,200m, from Q1 3,090m plus Q2 at roughly +5-8% on last year's 2,980m, comes out about +3% over that. This is a single estimate source plus a derived split, so every size is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register 0.49% (one seller), down 0.02pt and so mildly covering, as of 2026-09-29 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, from the baseline). 信用倍率 11.2x (kabutan, 2026-10-14). In absolute terms the margin long is tiny: 92,900 shares on 2026-07-17 (https://irbank.net/6183/margin), about 0.12% of 74.5m shares and about 0.4 days of the 254,600-share daily volume, so the high ratio is not a crowded leveraged long. There is no option skew in this market. priced_lean_pct is -0.013, effectively neutral.

findings.finding: Operating profit is running ahead of last year's pace and of the plan. Q1 OP was 3,213m yen (+11.2% YoY), 24.7% of the 13,000m FY plan against 22.8% of the final figure at Q1 last year. Q1 pretax of 3,090m beat IFIS (2,900m) by 6.6%. Pricing increases and site consolidation carry the margin, so H1 OP is likely around +8-10% YoY against a FY plan of +2.8%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: July 2026: Q1 OP +11.2% and pretax 6.6% above IFIS, and the stock fell 1.73% the next session (1386 to 1362, Yahoo bars). Kabutan headlines: '3～5月期決算堅調も目先材料出尽くし感' and '第1四半期想定線も売り上げ伸び悩みなどマイナス視'. Profit beats on this name have been sold.
findings.why_not_priced: Only partly unpriced. The Q1 progress rate is public, but the FY consensus (12,817m pretax) sits only 1.7% above the plan, so a full-year profit pace of +8-10% is not in the street number. If it were priced, the IFIS consensus would have moved up after the Q1 beat. Instead it went down 1.3% in the following week (kabuyoho 'コンセンサス変化' 2026-07-15 and 07-21).
findings.independence: IFIS Q1 beat note and the consensus history: https://kabuyoho.jp/reportNews?bcode=6183. Different publisher, same underlying Q1 data.

findings.finding: Revenue is not tracking the +4.2% plan. Q1 was +0.3%, with staffing-related (人材関連) clients down 5.1億 yen YoY, and the Q1 progress rate was 24.1%. On 2026-10-13, after the close, dip (2379, a job-ad platform in that client industry) cut its FY outlook sharply (OP from 5-10bn yen to between -2.5bn and +2.5bn) on competition. That points to continued pressure on HR-client outsourcing spend into H2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: July 2026: revenue 'stagnation' was the cited reason for the -1.73% reaction despite the profit beat. October 2024: H1 printed revenue -5.6% in Q2 and the stock fell 6.08% the next session.
findings.why_not_priced: The revenue lag is computable from the Q1 tanshin and is held in the price (LESSONS rule 1), so only the dip read-through is new, and dip moved this morning. A read-through to a client industry is a proxy: dip is not named as a Bell24 client.
findings.independence: Q1 industry breakdown in the company's supplement (人材関連 down sharply): https://finance-frontend-pc-dist.west.edge.storage-yahoo.jp/disclosure/20260708/20260708589612.pdf

findings.finding: The stock closed lower the session after 9 of its last 11 results releases, measured on the real release dates from irbank's TDnet list with Yahoo closes: -5.98, +1.90, -3.81, -6.08, +1.21, -0.34, -2.93, -2.23, -1.02, -3.67, -1.73. The median is -2.23%. Both prior Q2 prints fell (-6.08 in 2024, -2.23 in 2025). The baseline's estimated-date history mislabels several of these dates.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This finding is the reaction history: 9 of 11 down, including after the July 2026 profit beat.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a reaction regularity, not a fact the price can absorb ahead of time. The stock already drifted -3.6% over 20 days into the print, though the 5-day run-up is +1.0%. If the pattern were priced, the pre-print drift would be larger and the post-print move would centre on zero. Eleven events is a thin sample (one-sided binomial p about 0.03), so this is sized small.
findings.independence: Daily closes from Yahoo: https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/6183.T?range=3y&interval=1d (different source for the prices; release dates from irbank).

outside_window.finding: Mid-term plan targets revenue CAGR 7.3% and OP CAGR 10.9%, and year one is tracking +0.3% revenue. Any reset of the plan would come at a later full-year print, not this H1.

baseline_tension: Neutral lean (-0.013), with a -3.6% 20-day drift that mildly agrees with the negative reaction pattern. The strongest positive the release could carry is H1 OP up about 8-10% YoY, ahead of a +2.8% plan, which could prompt an OP raise. I looked for a buyback, a dividend change or a pre-filed revision and found none, and the company's record says it will not raise mid-year. Two of three findings are negative, but the largest rests on a reaction regularity rather than a fundamental miss.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a progress rate computable from the last 短信): the revenue-lag finding was cut from -0.3 to -0.2, leaving only the new dip read-through, and p_up moved from 42 to 45

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): wrote the strongest positive (H1 OP pace, possible OP raise) into baseline_tension and confirmed no buyback or dividend change had been filed; the operating-profit finding stays at +0.3
